This fitness tracker watch features a 0.49-inch OLED screen and automatically records your daily activity including steps, distance, calories burned, and sleep patterns. The tracker provides sedentary reminders and alarm clock functions to help you maintain healthy habits throughout the day. The rechargeable lithium-polymer battery fully charges in approximately 2 hours and provides up to 3 days of working time. The comfortable TPU wristband with aluminum alloy construction ensures all-day wearability. Data syncs to the companion app by scanning the QR code in the user manual, storing up to 7 days of activity history in the app and 1 day on the device itself. The tracker offers comprehensive sleep monitoring with automatic detection and analysis to help you understand your sleep quality. Additional features include shake-to-photograph control, raise-to-wake screen activation, sports goal setting, and the ability to share your fitness achievements. This non-comedogenic, lightweight serum foundation covers everything from blemishes to acne scars to hyperpigmentation, all while visibly blurring pores. The extreme long wear formula controls shine all day and stands up to sweat and humidity.

What else you need to know

Packed with flexible elastomer pigments, this transfer-proof, full-coverage foundation blends and bends with skin for a natural-looking, flashback-free finish.

When you try, let it dry: this foundation's shades look different when wet vs. Fully dry because of the high percent of pigment and ingredients that help provide the extreme long wear. When you pick your shade, make sure to let it dry down completely to see the true color of the pigments.

- Check out the undertone descriptors and dry swatch photos to find your best match.

- Don't judge the shade by the bottle—most shades look deeper when fully dried down to the true color.

- Shake well before each use.

- Use a sponge to tap good apple into skin and build up to whatever level of coverage you want.

- Use a dense foundation brush with a buffing motion for more immediate full coverage.

Pump it up:

- Start with 1 pea-size drop for buildable full coverage.

- Use a full pump to add even more coverage.

- A little goes a long way.

Prep & set:

Start cleaning your tools like a PRO with Cinema Secrets Makeup Brush Cleaner and Cleansing Tin. Stubborn waterproof and long wear makeup melts away and brushes dry almost instantly, no water or rinsing required leaving a pleasant vanilla scent. The aluminum tin is perfect for the "Dipping Method" for deep cleaning and the twist-top lid fits tight to avoid spills on the job. As soon as brushes are dry to the touch they are ready to use.

Dipping Method Directions Pour It, Dip It, Wipe It. Three easy steps is all it takes to bring brushes back to life instantly. Pour CS Makeup Brush Cleaner into our Cleansing Tin and fill the tin up enough to dip 1/4 of the way up the brush bristles. Dip the tip of the brush into the liquid and remove immediately to avoid over saturation. The bristles will draw liquid up into the brush and dissolve away makeup. For large, fluffy, or dense brushes, only dip 10% of the brush tip and hold vertically for 5 seconds so liquid moves down into the base. Wipe the brush clean on an absorbent paper towel or cloth, and repeat as necessary. Reshape the brush and allow to air dry completely before use.

Caution:

May stain light or white brushes.

Do not dip brush more than halfway, over saturate or soak.

description:
Artistry meets simplicity! Pre-Mapped Extensions takes the guesswork out of placement with an easy-to-follow blueprint for creating today’s most sought-after, salon-requested styles in the comfort of your home. Mapping, a technique used by lash techs, is all about the optimal blending of different lengths and curls and their strategic placement along the lash line to achieve the look you’re going for. With pre-mapping, the work is done for you to simplify, save time and sidestep mistakes. Our professional lash tech designed the ideal cat eye map with graduating lengths that progressively elongate toward the outer corner for an upswept effect. With 7-8-mm at the inner corner, 10 mm at the center and elongating to 13 mm at the outer corner for a defined feline flare, the winged profile makes eyes appear lifted, longer and seductive. Segments are contoured to your eye shape for a smooth finish. Boot tweezer dupes the style used in salons, with a 40-degree angle at the neck to make it easier to reach corners for utmost comfort and control. Lashes are made from feather-light fibers that look and feel like the strands lash artists use. Complete kit with Duo Long-wear Clear Glue for up to 3 days of wear plus Duo Lash Remover for easy removal.

Benefits:
• Top salon-inspired styles, designed and mapped out by a professional lash artist.

• Turn out perfect Cat eye sets every time.

• Winged flare elongates the eye for an instant cat eye lift.

• Medium volume and length, with a soft C Curl effect.

• Captivating on all eye shapes, especially round, almond, hooded and downturned eyes.

• Millimeter numbers on tray = longest lengths of each lash segment.

• No girl math needed! Tray is laid out in an eye shape so you can easily copy the sequence on your eyes: start with outer corner extension and apply to your outer corner of your eyelid; continue, working towards inner corner.

• Versatile: apply above the lash line or below as an underlash.

• Segments are contoured to your eye shape for a smooth look.

• Lightweight fibers on flexible invisiband.

• Versatile: apply under or over lashes.

• Perfect for intermediate or expert lash users.

Features:
• Complete kit with the tools of the trade:

• Boot tweezer with 40-degree angle for comfort and control - like the style used in salon.

• Duo Clear Long-wear Glue provides up to 3 days of wear.

• Duo Lash Remover for easy removal.

• 4 applications with 4 segments for each eye.

How to use:
Read instructions carefully before beginning process.

PRO TIP: For Best results, curl lashes before application.

1.Before applying lashes, thoroughly clean your natural eyelashes and eyelids so they are free of makeup and oil.

2. Starting at the outer corner of the eye, apply a small coat of DUO Longwear Lash Glue either on top of lash or under your natural lashes. Gently apply glue near your natural lash line to mid-lash. DO NOT apply glue on skin, waterline, or lash tips. PRO TIP: Apply Duo Longwear Lash Glue Directly on Lash Extensions Band for a more precise application.

3. Gently remove lash extension from tray using the applicator.

4. Lay lash extension on top or attach it to the underside of your natural lashes. PRO TIP: To achieve a seamless look, overlap lash segments about 0.5 - 1MM.

5. Repeat steps 1-3 working towards the inner corner of the eye one section at a time.

6. Once complete, secure lashes by lightly squeezing natural lashes and Extensions together with applicator.

MAINTENANCE: Do not get lashes wet for 24 hours.

Removal: Moisten cotton swabs with the provided remover and gently massage the swabs back and forth until lashes fall off.

How to apply:

  1. Cut out the tattoo you want to use and remove the transparent film.
  2. Place the tattoo face down on your skin.
  3. Wet the tattoo thoroughly with a sponge or damp cloth.
  4. Peel the paper gently to see if it transferred (about 30 seconds). If not, press down and wet again.

Because it’s non-sticky and buildable, it’s ideal for last-minute set or bridal touchups—no feathering, no patchiness.

• Add a dewy highlight anywhere

Pro artists can dab a small amount on the high points of the cheekbones or eyelids (non-matte looks only) for a soft, glossy glow.

description:
Scarlet Moon Eau De Parfum is a gender-neutral scent that is versatile and intoxicating, easily transitioning from day to night with notes of vibrant rich Blood Orange, lush green Violet Leaf, and woodsy Japanese Hinoki. Created with 100% naturally derived botanical ingredients, it acts as a functional fragrance with aroma therapeutic benefits naturally found in the raw extracts it’s composed of. Uplifting Blood Orange brings feelings of joy and creates a sense of wellbeing, while verdant Violet Leaf and calming Japanese Hinoki inspire feelings of groundedness and comfort. Deeply mysterious, steeped in tradition, and laced with magic, this alchemical elixir blends a bright top chord of rich Blood Orange, bitter Petitgrain, and tantalizing Italian Mandarin. The sparkling top chord gives way to the verdant beauty of Violet Leaf. Sticky Galbanum resin blends with bright Fir Needle and cracks of feisty Black Pepper. The base of Scarlet Moon is built with exotic Hinoki wood and lush Cedar creating a feeling of nostalgia, warmth, and comfort. Using ancient perfumery traditions this handcrafted fragrance surpasses all industry standards of “clean” with its plant-based ingredients blended in organic, non-GMO sugarcane alcohol—no phthalates, no parabens, no synthetic dyes, no formaldehyde, vegan-friendly, and cruelty-free.

Fragrance Notes:
Top: Blood Orange, Petitgrain Heart, Italian Mandarin
Heart: Violet Leaf Absolute, Galbanum, Black Pepper, Fir Needle
Base: Hinoki, Cedarleaf, Virginia Cedarwood
